method: Second pass: every Italian source and Spanish translation read and semantically compared by a Claude Haiku 5.5 subagent; false assertions retained; corrections recorded with before/after and reason.

corrections.before: Quien esté obligado a registrar los períodos de conducción y no inserte la hoja de registro o la tarjeta del conductor está sujeto a una multa administrativa y a la suspensión de la licencia
